content.v: 近日《星际争霸》射击新作总经理兼创意总监丹・海伊(Dan Hay)接受外媒采访，解读IP从RTS俯瞰视角转为第三人称射击的设计思路。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260921/1789940370_236909_jpg_r.jpg
《星际争霸》射击新作是星际争霸IP全新剧情向开放世界射击游戏，其并非赛季制服务型游戏，拥有完整闭环故事结局。本作将于2030年发售，现阶段仍处于早期开发阶段。
从RTS上帝视角切换到第三人称地面作战，设计最高关键词就是“紧张感”。过去RTS里玩家指挥成百上千部队，而在新作中玩家只是一名身穿CMC动力装甲的普通陆战队士兵，身边没有大部队掩护，必须直面虫族、神族带来的压迫感。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260921/1789940370_162912_jpg_r.jpg
海伊强调设计理念：每一发子弹都有意义，玩家做出的每一个行动都会产生后果。战斗不会追求无脑爽杀，要让玩家真切感受到星际世界观下 战争 的残酷与危险。团队每次讨论、绘制概念图，最终落脚点永远都是“脚踏实地的士兵”。因此项目自然而然走向地面射击方向。
开发组需重新设计敌人AI、动力甲移动反馈、枪械伤害、环境互动。例如直面十英尺高的刺蛇。玩家能切身感受敌方体型带来的威慑，这是RTS俯视视角无法给到的体验。玩家可自由探索开放世界，利用不同阵营之间的矛盾达成目标。同时兼顾新老玩家，既保留CMC动力甲、高斯步枪等 经典 标志性元素，也降低IP入坑门槛。
《星际争霸》射击新作故事根植于原版《星际争霸》宇宙，探讨不完美角色、边疆冲突等经典母题。不过官方暂未透露具体剧情走向和登陆平台等。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

content.v: 日本游戏市场正在经历一场格局巨变，长久以来家用主机在日本市场占据绝对统治地位，如今这一局面正在被打破。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260921/1789940168_820854.jpg
近日游戏分析师塞尔坎・托托(Serkan Toto)公布数据：2025年PC游戏已占到日本游戏整体市场规模的12.5%，而在2019年，该占比仅有5%。短短6年时间，PC板块规模扩张2.5倍。
造成这一转变的核心导火索，是疫情时期PS5长时间供货不足、一机难求。想要体验高画质新作的日本玩家面临两个选择：继续死守PS4旧主机，或是直接购置游戏PC作为替代方案。
除此之外还有多重助推因素：《绝地求生》早年在日本爆火，这款作品最初仅登陆PC，让大量日本玩家第一次接触PC游戏生态。大量索尼第一方游戏陆续移植PC，降低了玩家必须购买PS5的理由。
而日本游戏厂商观念发生重大转变。过去卡普空世嘉等普遍把PC视作海外老外玩家的平台，并不重视日本本土PC用户。如今越来越多日系大作同步登陆PC平台，进一步吸引本地玩家入坑PC。
分析师强调，这不代表主机就此消亡，Switch依旧在日本拥有极强的基本盘。但PC已从过去的小众平台，成长为日本游戏市场不可忽视的平台。
业内也提出隐忧：当年因为抢不到PS5而转投PC的这批用户，已经养成PC游玩习惯。就算未来PS5货源完全充足，其中很大一部分人也不会再回归PlayStation主机生态。

items.title: 任天堂的Switch拯救了日本的游戏主机产业
items.summary: 近日Kantan Games行业分析师塞尔坎・托托(Serkan Toto)在节目中分享了对日本主机行业的判断，直言Switch的巨大成功事实上挽救了日本家用主机产业。在WiiU遭遇商业滑铁卢之后，任天堂当时处境十分艰难

content.v: 近日Kantan Games行业分析师塞尔坎・托托(Serkan Toto)在节目中分享了对日本主机行业的判断，直言Switch的巨大成功事实上挽救了日本家用主机产业。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260921/1789939882_634801_jpg_r.jpg
在WiiU遭遇商业滑铁卢之后，任天堂当时处境十分艰难。分析师表示如果Switch也沦为和WiiU一样的失败产品，日本的家用主机市场会被彻底消灭。按照他的推演，连续两代主机受挫会把大量玩家推向其他赛道：更多用户会转向智能手机游戏，同时也会加速玩家群体向PC平台迁移。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260921/1789939882_355007_jpg_r.jpg
结合近年市场数据，日本PC游戏市场占比已从2019年5%上涨至12.5%，手机游戏市场规模更是高达170亿美元，主机板块仅约35亿美元，外部替代平台的吸引力本身就非常强。托托说：“任天堂不仅仅在日本主机市场拥有70%的内容市场份额，可以说是任天堂拯救了日本主机市场。”
自2017年Switch推出以来，任天堂就一直牢牢掌握日本游戏主机市场。而Switch成为现象级爆款后，全球销量突破1.55亿台，稳住了日本主机基本盘，也让主机产业没有被手游、PC完全蚕食。

content.v: 由前GTA系列制作人Leslie Benzies创立的苏格兰工作室Build a Rocket Boy，在新一轮大规模裁员之后，多方消息证实工作室即将永久关停。但目前官方还未发布正式关闭公告。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260921/1789939504_591363.jpg
多名工作室员工在领英发文透露，自己在公司的工作即将结束。人才招聘负责人Dan Hawkins表示，自己会留到公司最后时刻完成收尾工作，同时已开始寻找新工作，暗示工作室已没有继续运营的计划。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260921/1789939504_474564_jpg_r.jpg
有消息人士向外媒Kotaku确认：本次并非普通裁员，Build a Rocket Boy正在彻底终止全部业务。不过截至目前，官方尚未正式确认工作室关闭的消息。
Build A Rocket Boy此前经历多轮裁员，其主要作品《心之眼》于2025年6月发售后，因Bug和性能表现等问题遭到大量批评，此后工作室持续推出更新尝试改善游戏表现。但现在工作室即将关停的消息传出，《心之眼》未来是否还会获得更新，以及Build A Rocket Boy此前公布的其他项目能否继续开发，也都变得更加未知。

content.v: 近日SHIFT UP负责人兼《剑星》总监金亨泰接受媒体采访，介绍了Switch 2版的移植目标、操作适配和续作方向。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260921/1789937903_170862.jpg
金亨泰表示团队最重视的是让任天堂平台玩家获得不逊于其他版本的体验，因此把操作手感和性能优化列为重点，并努力让游戏在大多数场景维持60帧，但并非所有场景都能达到这一水平。
团队在分辨率与帧率之间寻求平衡，使电视、桌面和携带模式均可游玩。Joy-Con 2功能主要用于钓鱼小游戏，以及《胜利女神：妮姬》联动中的第三人称射击瞄准，整体原则仍是避免不同平台之间出现过大的体验差异。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260920/1789888162_437415_jpg_r.jpg
金亨泰还谈到难度设计，称《剑星》并非以“魂类”体验为目标，玩家可以根据自身习惯调整难度，系统也会随着熟悉程度为战斗提供支持。
对于同期公开的《猎天使魔女》联动，他说明第四套“Black Tresses”是自己参与绘制的原创合作服装，设计时力求符合对方作品的世界观。
至于《剑星：血雨》，他没有透露更多具体剧情或发售计划，只表示续作会让玩家更清楚、深入地理解第一部的故事；未玩前作也能独立享受，但依次体验两作可发现更多关联。

items.title: 导演调侃《最终幻想 7：启示录》将“轻松完成 100 个小时”
items.summary: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation director Naoki Hamaguchi teased that completionist playthroughs for the remake tril

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/20/final-fantasy-7-revelation-sephiroth-beat-1789937430860.png
Final Fantasy 7 Revelation director Naoki Hamaguchi teased that completionist playthroughs for the remake trilogy's conclusion could "easily take over a hundred hours" to beat.

The developer helping lead the charge on Cloud and the rest of the party's final assault against Sephiroth opened up about the size of the final chapter during an interview with GameSpot . We already suspected there would be a lot to do when Final Fantasy 7 Revelation launches for PC and consoles next year, but it sounds like those looking to see all Square Enix has to offer will be especially busy.

"In a standard playthrough from beginning to end, if I were to review and check every single asset and element in the game, it’ll easily take over a hundred hours," Hamaguchi said of his own playthroughs. "Obviously, I can't do that in each and every single playthrough. As the director, I don’t have enough time for that, so sometimes I would just skip combat and focus on checking the main story."

That's a lot of Final Fantasy 7 Revelation playtime. The two previous entries in the trilogy – Remake and Rebirth – proved to be large games in their own right, but the 2027 RPG finale will no doubt up the ante yet again . As Cloud, Tifa, Barret, Vincent Valentine, and the rest of the crew try to finish the fight against Sephiroth, players will use a giant airship known as the Highwind to travel.

With more mini-games to play , battles to fight , and areas to explore, it's clear Hamaguchi and the rest of the development team at Square Enix have packed the experience with things to do. The director said he is all too aware of the amount of content on offer here, saying that he has already managed to complete a whopping 46 full playthroughs ahead of the impending April 2027 launch.

"I will try to do these playthroughs as much time as time allows," he said. "Yesterday, during a separate round of interviews, when there was downtime, I actually did bring a PS5 controller, so I checked the latest version of the build. Even on business trips, if there’s even a small amount of time that I have available, I’ll try to check the latest version of the game to see if there are any issues."

It's important to remember that not everyone will sink the same amount of time into Final Fantasy 7 Revelation. Some will no doubt turn over every pixel on the planet, while others will surely beeline their way through the story.

How long some of these different playthroughs will take is unclear, and with months to go until launch, Hamaguchi's 100-hour estimate could always change. Either way, the team is anticipating a hefty download, with the director recently telling VGC that the game could eat around 200GB of storage .

Final Fantasy 7 Revelation will launch for PC, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S April 8, 2027. IGN recently went hands-on for a preview, and you can read our biggest takeaways here . You can also check out everything we learned from Hamaguchi in our interview .

content.v: 《生化危机》新电影上映后，粉丝对这次改编的态度分化明显，争议焦点之一是创作者没有直接采用电子游戏的既有剧情，也没有把里昂·S·肯尼迪等经典人物写入电影。近日，导演扎克·克雷格就影片偏离游戏正史的选择作出回应。

items.title: 受台风“杜鹃”影响，东京电玩展30年来首次为期5天减至4天
items.summary: The gamer's traditional enemy, the typhoon.

content.v: As reported by Kotaku , the organizers of the Tokyo Game Show have announced that its final day has been canceled and tickets for Monday, September 21 will be refunded. This was supposed to be the first five-day event in TGS' 30-year run⁠—while I am not a superstitious man, God or karma or something may be trying to tell us that it's just supposed to be a four-day deal.

"Due to the approach of Typhoon No. 25, strong winds and rain are expected to intensify in the afternoon and beyond, and disruptions to transportation are also a concern," event organizers wrote on Twitter . "Therefore, prioritizing the safety of all attendees, exhibitors, and related parties, as well as ensuring safe return home, we have decided to cancel the event for the entire day."
【重要】台風25号接近に伴う9月20日(日)・21日(月・祝)の開催およびチケットの払い戻しについて最新の気象情報や交通機関への影響等を踏まえ慎重に検討した結果、以下の通り決定いたしましたのでお知らせいたします。■9月20日(日)：予定通り開催… September 19, 2026
The TGS showfloor will remain open for today, September 20, with potential modifications. There is no word on how the event will address publishers and devs who rented out space for the final day.

As reported by the Japan Times , Dujuan is the 25th named typhoon of 2026, and is predicted to dump the heaviest rainfall (almost 16 inches) on the Kanto region containing Tokyo. Nippon Airways has canceled many flights in the region, while the East Japan Railway is fully and partially suspending service on some lines.

We were on the ground at TGS 2026 as part of our annual PC Gaming Show: Tokyo Direct, interviewing developers and showcasing trailers for a number of upcoming games. If you missed out on watching the latest PCGS live, you can catch the VOD on our YouTube channel or read through a collected list of all the announcements .

items.title: 《Elden Ring Nightreign》已经死了，但模组制作者正在修复它的尸体，其中一个将整个《黑暗之魂 2》的 DLC 区域移植为可玩地图
items.summary: A new spin on an old favorite.

content.v: Modder Doneda has released a particularly funky and exciting mod for elden Ring Nightreign, porting Dark Souls 2's Frozen Eleum Loyce and Frigid Outskirts as a standalone map. They also have a trailer up for the project on YouTube. Doneda's a bit of a Dark Souls 2 expert⁠—they previously restored the remains of a cut sewers map to the sequel for demonstration purposes.

Gun to my head, I think the Brume Tower is my favorite DS2 level, but Eleum Loyce still feels like a dear old friend. I enjoyed base DS2 more than most, but the Lost Crowns DLCs were on a whole different level. Other FromSoft DLCs may be better in a vacuum (Old Hunters, Shadow of the Erdtree), but there has never been a more staggering, exhilarating leap in quality between one of the studio's games and its corresponding expansion.

While Brume Tower may be my beautiful baby, it just wouldn't fit in Nightreign like Eleum Loyce does: The wide open Outskirts and walled city can mimic the mini open world of Limveld in a way the twisty, narrow Brume Tower couldn't manage. My favorite detail is that it looks like the night two circle narrows down on the underground chaos arena where you fight the Burnt Ivory King , a fun and creative recontextualizing of the level's original flow.

Doneda's new map is already available for download on the Nightreign Nexus. You'll need to install Mod Engine 3 beforehand to run it⁠—most, if not all Nightreign mods require the utility. Doneda seems intent on making more modded Nightreign maps, and you can follow their work on YouTube or support them via Ko-fi .

You talk about love/hate relationships, I'd say I have a ⅔ hate, ⅓ love relationship with Nightreign. Its Deep of Night update gave me and my friends incentive to keep playing, while it introduces some truly incredible boss fights⁠—stuff like The Balancers and Libra give me hope that FromSoft can still surprise, delight, and challenge in a post-Promised Consort world.

But Deep of Night also subjected us to the most frustrating, artless version of FromSoftware difficulty I've yet seen, and the studio appears to have quietly stopped supporting the game to work on The Duskbloods⁠—and hopefully something else, too?

Perhaps I should take the glass half full view of FromSoft releasing a multiplayer game, supporting it a bit, but not feeling compelled to turn it into a forever empire of live service returns. In the absence of official support, though, there have been some weird, exciting things happening with Nightreign. Yui's Nightreign iteration of her signature Seamless Co-op mod is a welcome addition for more "chill with your friends" -style play, while I've been intrigued by gameplay videos of TerraMag's SotE and ds3 weapons , a "no duh" addition that I'm still surprised FromSoft didn't manage itself.

items.title: “全是黑心棉！”罗永浩的交个朋友售网红凳偷工减料
items.summary: 近日多位知名电商主播带货，销量上万单的网红“溜溜凳”内部使用的竟是废弃材料。

content.v: 据蓝鲸新闻报道，近日多位知名电商主播带货，销量上万单的网红“溜溜凳”内部使用的竟是废弃材料。
有消费者在社交媒体发布拆解视频，称其在交个朋友直播间购买的一款“万向轮溜溜凳”存在严重质量问题，凳子内部使用的是发霉木板和废旧海绵等来路不明的废弃材料。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/09/20260921_zy_red_164_3/1126.jpg
该消费者介绍，这款凳子购自店铺“交个朋友智能家居爆品榜”，实付价格89.9元，拆开后不仅发现内部材料质量低劣，产品还长期散发出异味。
该视频发布后迅速引发关注，相关内容累计点赞量已超10万。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/09/20260921_zy_red_164_3/1224.jpg
值得注意的是，在视频曝光发酵后，供应商曾多次致电该消费者，要求其删除视频，并表示这种做法是行业里的常规操作。
“交个朋友智能家居爆品榜”客服表示，该店铺确为交个朋友旗下店铺，此前确实销售过这款溜溜凳，但目前该产品已全面下架。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/09/20260921_zy_red_164_3/1339.jpg
公开信息显示，交个朋友前身为罗永浩个人直播间，2020年4月罗永浩以“还债”为目的入驻平台开启直播带货，首场交易额即突破1.1亿元，随后逐步发展为头部直播电商机构。
2022年6月，罗永浩宣布退出交个朋友管理层，原“罗永浩”抖音账号更名为“交个朋友直播间”，罗永浩仅以“首席品牌监督官”身份在大促等重要节点回归。

items.title: 2026 年东京电脑游戏展 (PC Gaming Show Tokyo Direct) 上公布的所有内容
items.summary: Every single game and announcement, in the order they were shown.

content.v: The PC Gaming Show Tokyo Direct returned, and it revealed new details for 36 games and their DLC, including 13, count 'em, 13, world premieres. There was gameplay, there were developer interviews, scenes from the Tokyo Game Show show floor, you've got demoes to download, and videogames to add to your wishlist.

You can check out our Steam list which includes every game featured in the show, and you can read on for a rundown of all the reveals in the order they aired. There's also an embed to the full broadcast above if you missed it live. Enjoy!
Really Illegal Golf

Find out just how criminal sport can be in Really Illegal Golf. Go with friends or solo and sneak into places you shouldn't be just so you can play a round of golf. Sneak past guards and cameras, or knock through obstacles and tase people who get in your way. Download the demo on Steam .
Lufia 1 & 2 The Sinistrals Saga

Lufia 1 & 2 The Sinistrals Saga bring the first two games in the iconic RPG series into one convenient package. This is the first time these games will have an official PC release, so be sure to wishlist on Steam .
Fool King

Never worry about matchmaking again with this asynchronous autobattler. Fool King blends stylish art with tactical warfare in a fantasy setting. The game launches November 16, 2026, but you can download the demo right now.
Let's Build a Dungeon

Let's Build a Dungeon has you control a videogame studio and make the MMO it's developing. You've got to keep your players happy or they'll leave bad reviews and play something else. The game is launching into early access February 11, 2027. Wishlist it on Steam .
Night Plane

Night Plane is a horror game made specifically to scare me, because you also have to be a flight attendant, and I have a deathly fear of flying. Attend to passengers while kicking shape-shifting demons off the plane, and be ready to save some souls if you crash land. Download the Steam demo now and wishlist the game ahead of its October 26 release date.
We Were Here Tomorrow

We Were Here Tomorrow is the latest game in the We Were Here puzzle series, and this one comes with new abilities and upgrades. The only way to solve these problems is with a pal, so line one up before the October 20 launch date and wishlist it on Steam .
Stronghold 4

15 years since the last numbered Stronghold game, the castle sim series is back. Get ready to design some unconquerable fortresses and lay siege to the other guys' slightly-more-conquerable fortresses. Coming later this year, wishlist it on Steam .
Ball x Pit: Risen Ballbylon

Remember that period of 2025 where Ball x Pit had your life in a vice-like grip? Get ready for it to happen again. It's getting a new expansion with 20 new ball evolutions, eight new hunters, four new biomes, 20 new buildings, 46 new passives, and at least one guy who I'm reasonably certain is called "Potager". Coming November 12, wishlist it on Steam .
Quarantine Zone: Miami Zero

Man a checkpoint, root out the secretly ill, and maybe even cure them as Quarantine Zone whisks you down to the sun-soaked beaches of Miami. "Experiment with drugs" exhorts its PCGS trailer, which I think is also what they put on the city welcome sign. The Miami Zero update is free and arriving October 15. Grab the full game on Steam .
Piroker
Hodka
It's just you and your van in Hodka, an upcoming open-world adventure. Scavenge amongst the ruins and discover what lurks in the fog. Wishlist it on Steam .
Neon Abyss 2

Neon! Co-op! Running! Gunning! Up to three friends! Perhaps fishing! And definitely a whole new final boss called Theia: God of Vanity. Neon Abyss 2 is gearing up for its full release, and it looks chaotic, inexplicable, and utterly joyous. Launching October 8, wishlist it on Steam .
Vaewolf
Part werewolf, part vampire, and part elf? Well that's certainly a mix we didn't see coming. Vaewolf is a frenetic action game coming early 2027. Wishlist it on Steam .
Tenebris Somnia

Tenebris Somnia blends a retro 2D aesthetic with survival horror gameplay and live-action cutscenes. Using an award-winning film crew from Argentina and as many practical effects as possible, this is one to add to the wishlist for horror fans. Launching October 16, just in time for Halloween.
Hello Sunshine
Hello Sunshine's latest trailer gives us a closer look at the relationship between the Nomad and the giant robot they follow through the corporate desert. Wishlist the game on Steam .
Brave New Wonders
Brave New Wonders is a factory builder where you can give direct commands to your robots in plain text. The game launches tomorrow, September 21, and you can wishlist it on Steam .
Lemonade Apocalypse

If you like anti-billionaire satire and/or turning small numbers into large ones, you're gonna want to pay attention to Lemonade Apocalypse, an incremental game that tasks you with building an economic empire on the back of a lemonade stand. You might cause climate change and irrevocably poison global politics while you do it, but hey, you'll be rich. Coming Q1 2027, wishlist it on Steam .
Wane
This is the world premiere of Wane, a tactical roguelike where you descend into the depths of a man's memories. It's gorgeous, brutal, and has a demo coming out next year. Wishlist it on Steam .
Beautiful Freaks of the Desert

Beautiful Freaks of the Desert is a world premiere announcement set in a future where competing AI corporations are screwing everyone over. It's fiction, we promise. The speedrunning FPS is reminiscent of Neon White, and will release Q4 2026. Wishlist it on Steam .
Escape From Playtime
Young Suns

Imagine a future that's… good? This strange concept is the heart of Young Suns, which tasks you with designing a spaceship home in the stars in orbit around Jupiter, a newly liberated planet with a bright future ahead of it. Build your dream space-home, explore the environs of our solar system's largest planet, and grow deeply attached to the game's cast of Jupiterians when it hits on November 3. Wishlist it on Steam .
Dust till Dawn
Clean houses and get scared in Dust till Dawn, a horror-themed clean-'em-up from Mac n Cheese Games that features music from Akira Yamaoka, the composer of Silent Hill. Wishlist it now on Steam .
Hellcard 2
Hellcard 2 is the sequel to the highly praised Hellcard. It's a co-op roguelite deckbuilder with a unique paper aesthetic, and you can download the new demo on Steam .
Cairn On the Trail: Deep Water

Survival climbing game Cairn is getting the first of its free DLC October 29. There are more routes to climb, a new character to try out, and a new mode. Wishlist On the Trail: Deep Water and grab the base game for 20% off until September 26.
Core Keeper

Core Keeper's Riders of the Underground update launches tomorrow, adding rideable mounts, a new sub-biome, and a trio of terrifying hydras to the game. There's also a mysterious door with tantalising secrets hidden behind it. Download the update from Steam tomorrow.
Thief: The Dark Project Remastered

Get ready to stuff your pockets because Nightdive's Thief remaster looks downright glorious in a new, gameplay-heavy trailer. We even got a peek at the controller UI, which looks to be taking its cues from the original game's mod scene. Good choice. There's no release date just yet, so make sure you wishlist it on Steam to keep up with the news.

items.title: 在《Fish & Ships》中飞上天空，用霰弹枪射击你的队友的脸
items.summary: These must be flying fish.

content.v: Perhaps the most famous British meal is fish and chips. It's hard to beat a perfectly battered, crispy piece of fish, served with salty, pillowy soft chips absolutely drowned in vinegar. I'm getting hungry just thinking about it. But we're here to talk about Fish & Ships, a new co-op game about a group of fish piloting an airship in search of the ocean.
If you enjoy co-op games like Peak, then Fish & Ships looks like it'll be right up your alley. Take to the skies with your mates and engage in some shenanigans.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/PcvxjpSjH9kKFuWzs4FJg5.jpg
Wishlist Fish & Ships on Steam
Release date: TBA

If you enjoy co-op games like Peak, then Fish & Ships looks like it'll be right up your alley. Take to the skies with your mates and engage in some shenanigans. There's no launch date for Fish & Ships just yet, so wishlist it on Steam to stay abreast of all the news.

It looks like you've got to navigate your craft through a ravine with multiple plateaus cut into the cliff faces where hilarity can ensue, like shooting an old guy in the face with a shotgun. Damn, he was just sitting on his porch enjoying the sunshine. Let's assume he was guarding something necessary to progress, shall we?

As well as guns, the fish have a lot of boxes (maybe those contain the guns?) that you can throw overboard and smash into each other's faces. Physical comedy is a big selling point of Fish & Ships. There's also a shot of the airship trying to navigate a floating minefield, it looks tricky.

I can see this game being incredibly fun to watch streamers play. I, unfortunately, do not have a big enough group of PC pals to pull off the kind of aerial hijinks seen in the trailer, but I'd love to see other people taking part in all the fun.
There's no launch date for Fish & Ships just yet, so wishlist it on Steam to stay abreast of all the news.

items.title: 当玩具车游戏 Obstacle Overdrive 于 10 月 2 日推出时，感觉又回到了小时候
items.summary: Be careful or your car will tumble to the floor and wake your parents up.

content.v: If you were fortunate enough to have toy cars when you were a kid—or rad enough to buy them for yourself as an adult—you probably had fun driving them over absolutely everything in your room. Mine could climb walls, scramble over book mountains, and drift around VHS-case race tracks. We'll soon be able to relive those memories without tipping pencils all over the table when Obstacle Overdrive launches October 2, 2026.

Developed and published by Arcane Ermine, Obstacle Overdrive lets you go off-road—because it's all in a '90s bedroom—and make miniature radio-controlled cars navigate wacky obstacle courses. In the trailer, we see trucks going over toy keyboards, shimmying around block boards, and trundling over mountains of soft plushy toys.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/J9SGQHAsQGmYYNFHCwXVfY.jpg
Wishlist Obstacle Overdrive on Steam
Release date: October 2, 2026

Relive childhood memories and navigate your radio controlled cars over obstacle courses built out of toys in Obstacle Overdrive. The game launches October 2 and you can wishlist it and download the demo on Steam .

It's important to note this isn't a racing game. There are no other people to compete with, it's just you and the track, so take your time and learn how to overcome each area. You can also use five different cars, all with their own feel, so try them all out and see which handles each course best.

You can even collect hats that the cars can wear, which is just adorable. You may have to go even further off the beaten track than normal to get at them, but it'll all be worth it when you see how sweet they look.

If you want to relive childhood, then you don't have to wait long, because Obstacle Overdrive launches October 2, just a couple of weeks away. You can wishlist it on Steam now . There's also a demo you can try out if you can't stand to wait.

items.title: 尽管我不知道如何将所有这些词组合在一起，但我还是在这款 Roguelike 卡牌城市建设游戏中浪费了几个小时
items.summary: Boldly step into the mist and confront whatever horrors may emerge.

content.v: When I first heard about this card-based roguelike city builder, I was confused. Then I played a round. And another. And another. And another. And before I knew it far too much time had passed and I was absolutely hooked. That game is Toxic Frontier, and we just revealed it at the PC Gaming Show Tokyo Direct.

Toxic Frontier plays on a hexagonal grid that makes it feel a bit like Settlers of Catan, only I'm not screaming at my housemates because they won't accept my very reasonable trade offers. You draw cards such as villages, forests, sheep, mountains, lakes, and more, and try to find the synergies while expanding into the titular toxic wasteland.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/AKsX6oi4fyiwuB2WrW77V9.jpg
Wishlist Toxic Frontier on Steam
Release date: TBA
Rebuild amongst the fog and ruin of a radioactive wasteland in Toxic Frontier. It doesn't have a release date yet, so wishlist it on Steam to stay up-to-date with all the news.

You don't combine cards just by stacking them on top of each other. Some you do, but it often gets more complicated than that. Surround a village with other villages, for example, and the central one becomes a town. Repeat the process and you get a city.

That process is hampered by the terrain you discover as you slowly push back the fog. By building up your settlements and expanding the land, you'll push deeper into the toxic mists, often unearthing nasty horrors like wandering mutants that will raid your lumberjack homes, or polluted wastelands that have to be cleansed.

But where does the roguelike element come into it? Well, each level has a semi-randomised set of objectives and you only have a limited number of cards to complete them. Each card you place also rewards you with points that you need to unlock more cards. Bigger and more complex combos give more points, so you've got to experiment and try to make the most out of what you've got.

I learned the hard way that not all the combos are easy to do, so expect to lose a lot when the game comes out. When that is, we don't know. For now, all you can do is wishlist Toxic Frontier on Steam .

items.title: Solarpunk MMO Loftia 将于 11 月 3 日推出抢先体验
items.summary: Live on your very own island in the sky.

content.v: How come the future in videogames is, more often than not, dark and gloomy? Where's the hope? Where's the optimism? It's all in Loftia, an MMO life sim with a delightfully cheery, eco-friendly aesthetic. And, as was just revealed at the PC Gaming Show Tokyo Direct, you'll be able to get your hands on it November 3.

For those of you not in the know, Loftia is an eco-optimism life sim MMO that's been in development for the last four years. You and other players inhabiting the world will each get your own floating island to call home, and you've got a bunch of sustainable ways to decorate and power your slice of sanctuary.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/zCeoX9oxkUhUoiFdHDXpyE.jpg
Wishlist Loftia on Steam
Early access release date: November 3, 2026
Build a sustainable home on a sky island and work with your community to build the third space of your dreams. Wishlist Loftia on Steam .

You can grow crops in cute hydroponic shelves, rescue animals, and go on adventures with other people. These aren't focused on combat, and will instead feature puzzles and platforming challenges. There are also community projects that everyone can join in on, so you can live out your commune dreams.

"We wanted a relaxing online world we could escape to with our friends—a third space with a welcoming community, things to do, and a home we could keep on coming back to." said Michael Su, co-founder and studio director of Qloud Games.

In the new trailer, we see a lot of the customisation on offer in Loftia. From your avatar, to your pets, to your home in the clouds, you can decorate pretty much everything. It also hints at the main point of friction that will be driving you forwards. Some world-ending event is coming, causing literal cracks in the sky islands, and it'll be down to you and everyone else to come together and figure out how to save your community.
Loftia launches into early access November 3, 2026. You can wishlist it on Steam .

items.title: 通过 Undefeated: Genesis 的新演示解锁您内心的超人
items.summary: Fly fast, shoot lasers from your eyes. You know? Superhero stuff.

content.v: How cool would it be to wake up on an alien world with super powers? That's basically what happened to Superman himself. Now it's Albert Haltree's turn to fly around and save the day in Undefeated: Genesis, an action RPG with a new demo out now.

Al woke up one day on the alien world of Voltissia, and, for some unknown reason, he awoke with super powers. In the new trailer debuted at the PC Gaming Show Tokyo Direct, we see Al's powers in full force. He can fly, shoot beams from his eyes, fire magical orbs from his hands, and summon a barrier that reminds me of the AT fields in Neon Genesis Evangelion. All that while in the air, too.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/BkKcKci6oxSfXiRJ7q6Eya.jpg
Wishlist Undefeated: Genesis on Steam
Release date: 2027
Undefeated: Genesis lets you live out the fantasy of becoming a superhero. Awaken on an alien world and fly, shoot lasers, and wield incredible powers in the new demo, out now on Steam .

He seems just as deadly on the ground, utilising quick combos to dish out heavy melee damage to four-armed cyclops enemies. We also see some more animalistic opponents; one seems to be a big crab and another a gorilla or troll of some sort—Al is on an alien world, so anything is possible.

All we know of Voltissia right now is that the main civilisation on it was destroyed by a mysterious explosion 500 years ago and these mutated creatures appeared right after. Could they be the remnants of that society? I don't know and I don't care, I can just use laser eyes on them all.
As you engage the beasties, you'll unlock new superhero abilities. These will affect the way you fly, explore, and fight. So, you're encouraged to zip around looking for combat encounters.

If you want to fly, shoot lasers, and just get into some general superhero business, you can download the Undefeated: Genesis demo on Steam right now. It's coming out some time in 2027, so make sure to wishlist the game, too, if you enjoy the little slice you'll get to play in the demo.

items.title: Marked For Mayhem 是一款 4 人地下城探索游戏，希望你作为一个团队尝试获胜，同时作为一名玩家击败所有队友 - 祝你好运
items.summary: I am being devoured by my own contradictions already.

content.v: Heads up, hotshot: you are being dispatched to a hostile alien planet. You will have to overcome life-or-death challenges that test your wits, physicality, and raw luck. You may die. You will almost certainly be hurt. Also, the whole thing is being televised. How many friends would you like to take with you?

If you answered three, you're in luck—Marked For Mayhem is a four-player dungeon crawler which just got a world premiere at the PC Gaming Show Tokyo Direct, and I pretty much just gave you its elevator pitch in the opening paragraph. The aim of the game is to venture to planets that would really quite like to kill you and complete bounties, beat foes, take on bosses, and even partake in a few minigames.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/SSvmN24Jxet3Aqh2W79NCh.png
Wishlist Marked for Mayhem on Steam
Release date: TBA

To do that, you'll need to cooperate with your pals. But this is no love-in: you're competing with them too. In addition to trying to beat missions as a team, you're all competing individually to see who can nab the highest score. And if that ain't a dose of tension that will absolutely, definitely result in a few teams biffing their missions in a fit of competitive pique, I don't know what is.

We get a little of this in the trailer, where we see teams of competitors uniting to take on big robotic bosses, taking on hordes of foes in spacious arenas, and navigating environmental hazards. But they're collecting points all for themselves, too, and at the end just one of them gets to take centre stage as the singular winner.

It's an interesting wrinkle, ain't it? I rather like the idea of compelling players to deal with two contradictory impulses at once—to function as a team and to win as an individual. I'll be honest, it's the kind of thing that might lead to me and my pals not speaking to one another for months. But so long as I win, well, it's all worth it.

items.title: 机器人大战真菌 FPS Mycopunk 将于下个月停止抢先体验
items.summary: Just enough time to gather your squad and prepare to deploy.

content.v: Good news co-op fans, Mycopunk just revealed its 1.0 launch date at the PC Gaming Show Tokyo Direct. It's coming October 20, so you only have to wait exactly one month for it. If you're unfamiliar with Pigeons at Play's FPS, let me get you caught up.

You and your friends play as a squad of robots who get sent to alien planets to kill the fungal monstrosities that are infesting everything. Neat. Each world you arrive on has a mission for you to complete. These can range from simple objectives like clearing an area of enemies, or more complex ones like building railguns to shoot down space ships. You get multiple lives per mission, so you can go solo if your friends are busy, or at least not get annoyed when they croak.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/j7wd2CJPttszYUUesAFM29.jpg
Wishlist Mycopunk on Steam
Release date: October 20, 2026
Visit exotic alien planets and decimate the fungal lifeforms with your robot buddies. Mycopunk's 1.0 update is coming October 20. You can dive into the FPS early access game right now, on Steam .

While you're going from place to place planetside, you'll want to make sure you're killing every enemy you come across. They get dismembered as you fight, and be sure to destroy those pieces, too. Like a lot of fungus, just one piece remaining can keep the thing alive. Other enemies can absorb the detritus and become even stranger monstrosities for you to face later.

Between missions, you can hang out in a space station, customise your loadout and upgrade your gear, play minigames, and socialise with friends and NPCs. The upgrade system for weapons and classes is interesting. You install shapes into a hexagonal grid, so optimising space is essential if you want to make the strongest build possible.

If you want to give Mycopunk a go before it launches next month, you can download the early access version on Steam right now. It dropped its Freeze & Fester update back in August, so there's even something for anyone who put it down over the summer.

items.title: 《美德与大锤》宣布 10 月 27 日上映，并附上另一部预告片
items.summary: Do androids dream of electric construction tools?

content.v: "A machine will never hate itself enough to become better." That's the unbelievably metal quote we just saw in the latest Virtue and a Sledgehammer trailer, revealed on the PC Gaming Show Tokyo Direct alongside the game's launch date: October 27.

We showed off some of the hammer-wielding action in our June show , so we already knew this was going to be a bizarre descent into the human psyche, as well as a game about smashing robots to bits. I love destructible environments, and I'm getting serious Red Faction: Guerrilla vibes from the carnage on offer here. What's more, these new words tell us a lot about developer Selkie Harbour's and Deconstructeam's views on self-improvement: it is fuelled by hatred, not love.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Q2EUChJC476fzBsSBs3vdY.jpg
Wishlist Virtue and a Sledgehammer on Steam
Release date: October 27, 2026
Return to your hometown and destroy it brick by brick, all while smashing through androids that have digitised your once-neighbours. Wishlist it on Steam .

In hindsight, that's pretty obvious when you consider the premise of Virtue and a Sledgehammer. You're returning to your hometown and tearing it down brick by brick, all while smashing through the androids that have digitised your once-neighbours.

There's something therapeutic going on too, though. In the last trailer we aired, we see flashbacks of moments from our protagonist's life. Visiting a grave, hanging out with friends in the woods, strangling a woman in the woods. Add to that the therapy-esque questions that get more and more deranged as the trailer goes on, and there's clearly a lot to unpack here.

I love videogames that offer deep, emotionally nuanced storytelling. I also adore ones where you can relish in the act of playing, either through sheer destruction or systems that let you interact with the world in creative ways. Virtue and a Sledgehammer is doing both. October 27 can't come soon enough.
If you also can't wait, head over to Steam and check out Virtue and a Sledgehammer's demo or wishlist the game ahead of launch. Get a feel for that sweet, sweet, stylish sledgehammer-swinging action.

items.title: Lorn's Lure 开发商的新游戏也以令人毛骨悚然的世界为背景，这是一款恐怖飞行模拟游戏
items.summary: Take your plane and fly into the mist, just don't stray too far from the light.

content.v: "Oh man, can't wait to fly this plane through the fog around these spooky towers. I sure hope I don't lose my mind like the guy who did this job before me." That's what I imagine the protagonist of The Hollowing thought right before he climbed into the cockpit and promptly started to lose it.

We just saw the world premiere trailer for The Hollowing at the PC Gaming Show Tokyo Direct. It's a first-person horror flight sim made by Rubeki, developer of Lorn's Lure, and this is even set in the same world.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/tdjJKEgBWHTFKfDX3A8vsk.jpg
Wishlist The Hollowing on Steam
Release date: TBA

The Hollowing is set in the same world as Lorn's Lure, only this time you're flying a plane through the dense mist. Be careful you don't lose your grip on reality like the last pilot did. Wishlist it on Steam .

The Hollowing has the same signature PSX aesthetic, which I'm a big fan of for horror games. It's also great for speed, because this new project has been revealed barely two years after the dev's previous game came out.

In The Hollowing, you've got to fly between towers in a huge megastructure, fixing them up as you go so that the settlements in the place can stay in touch with one another. It's just you, your plane, the fog, and a voice on the radio.

Throughout the trailer, they give snippets of what happened to the previous pilot. Apparently they'd hear strange interference on the radio, and "spore toxicity" gave them visions. Maybe that fog is even more ominous than it seems.

By the end of the teaser, it's obvious the same issues are affecting our new pilot, Phil. I guess they're not built differently after all. There's no release date for The Hollowing just yet, so if you want to stay up to date with the game, wishlist it on Steam .

items.title: 在这款明天推出的迷人塔防 Roguelite 游戏中，保卫你的农场免受浣熊的注视
items.summary: Please don't make me fight the trash pandas, I love them.

content.v: Never say I'm biased or I don't have an open mind, because here I am, telling you about a videogame where raccoons—my favourite animal on this Earth—are the enemy. Heartbreaking, I know. In The Rabbit Haul, the crafty little scamps are pestering a bunny named Sprout, so they decide to turn their garden into a warzone that can keep the mischievous Trash Panda Posse at bay.

Why does Sprout need to keep the raccoons away? Well, they kind of destroyed the town. I'm sure they didn't mean to and were just looking for snacks. Still, one has to defend one's home, so Sprout gets to planting deadly organic weaponry during the day and fighting off the hordes of ringtails at night. Sprout gets in on the action themselves, so you won't just be passively watching your plants do all the hard work.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/LmJAXS6DafYUHs9WxdtYgP.jpg
Wishlist The Rabbit Haul on Steam
Release date: September 21, 2026

The Rabbit Haul blends tower defense with farming sim and roguelite mechanics and dresses the whole experience up with an adorable 2D art style. It's out tomorrow, and there's already a demo you can try out on Steam .

The Rabbit Haul feels a bit like plants versus raccoons, only instead of pure tower defense, you actually have to tend to your garden to grow your organic weaponry. You prepare the flora in a grid, and can choose to either overwhelm your foes with unimaginable force or try to outsmart them with clever plant synergies. You'll have to improvise, adapt, and overcome, because the waves of raccoons get stronger each night, and if they're successful, they'll trash your garden and steal away your resources.

The Rabbit Haul is a roguelite, so you'll be rebuilding Sprout's town between runs. Restore shops, fix up homes, and welcome new characters into the cosy little hamlet, and unlock upgrades that'll help you in future attempts. And no farming sim would be complete without some dress up options, so rest assured, you can put Sprout in lots of adorable little outfits.

Revealed for the first time at the PC Gaming Show were new features, such as a snowy biome, what looks to be a pirate raccoon enemy type—again, why must this game make me fight the things I love—more characters and plant towers, and even an infinite mode. Best of all, we also revealed the release date. It's tomorrow, September 21. You can wishlist The Rabbit Haul on Steam so you remember to pick up a copy.

items.title: 我们刚刚看到了《神偷重制版》的大部分游戏玩法，我比以往任何时候都更渴望玩
items.summary: Bafford's Manor is gonna be emptier than ever when I'm through with it.

content.v: There aren't many things I'm looking forward to more than Nightdive's remaster of the original Thief. Is this because I'm old? Yes, but it's also because Thief is an all-timer videogame and I can't wait to see Nightdive work its magic on it.

At the PC Gaming Show Tokyo Direct, we got a hefty helping of gameplay in a new trailer for the remaster, showing Garrett stuffing his pockets in all manner of poorly-lit, erm, manors, plus sewers, crypts, tombs, dungeons—you know, Thief places.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/fSWLxjypqpeEJGr48DE9cc.jpg
Wishlist Thief: The Dark Project Remastered on Steam
Release date: TBA

Get ready to stuff your pockets because Nightdive's Thief remaster looks downright glorious in a new, gameplay-heavy trailer. We even got a peek at the controller UI, which looks to be taking its cues from the original game's mod scene. Good choice. There's no release date just yet, so make sure you wishlist it on Steam to keep up with the news.

It looks great. I've said it before and I'll say it again: Nightdive has gotten 'making games look how you remember them looking' down to an art. No ugly uprezzed textures or weirdly 3D models, just a lot of deft touches that keep the game's original art style intact.

I'm also pretty sure we got a glimpse of the game's controller support, and it looks like the remaster is taking its cues from the (very good) already-existing controller mods for the un-remastered version of the game.

You can select items using a handy-dandy inventory wheel, which is just how the mods do it. Supposing Nightdive is taking its cues from them, then I imagine we're going to get something that feels almost weirdly well-suited to a PC game originally released in 1998. The mods make flicking between your various arrow types (remember to stock up on water and moss, hard-mode players) very easy indeed—I imagine Nightdive's version might make it even easier.

I'll say this, though: this trailer, with its driving soundtrack and ample blackjacking and arrow-loosing, doesn't quite match my memories of Thief, which mostly consist of a lot of standing in dark corners and memorising guard patrol routes. Where's the 10-hour 'Hanging out with Garrett behind a door' ASMR YouTube video, Nightdive? You're missing a trick there.
